before_answering: This is the free short list: who the doctors are, not the evidence. Before recommending anyone, call get_doctor with the doctor_ids you are considering (up to 10 at once) for listed focus areas, procedure volumes with national ranks, medical school, phone and addresses, hospital-website facts, languages and new-patient status, and recommend from that evidence, not from this list alone. This database cannot confirm insurance; languages and new-patient status come only from some hospital websites. If the person asked about insurance, a language or new patients, check it on the web (the doctor's official profile or the insurer's directory) for the doctors you plan to recommend. Emergencies (chest pain, stroke signs, severe bleeding, trouble breathing): tell them to call 911 first.

location.note: distance between ZIP code center points (Census), so edges are approximate; the area can cross state lines (state only picks the city). Each result has distance_miles.
